issue.title: the raw "Response" should'nt mandatory a content ... no ?

issue.body:
It's not the place to post that ...
But perhaps, somebody has already tested that ...

I've setuped a starlette app, on GoogleAppEngine standard env (2nd generation/python37)
with an app.yaml with an entrypoint like thoses (tested with the 2 variants): 
- gunicorn -w 2 -k uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker -b :$PORT main:app
- uvicorn --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT main:app

On local (dev_appserver) or in the cloud (appspot's instance)
Things seems to work (except: streamed responses are sended in one block, websockets doesn't seems to be available)

But on the appspot's instance : some simple requests ends in 500, with this simple message in the logs : 

    The process handling this request unexpectedly died. This is likely to cause a new process to be used for the next request to your application. (Error code 203) 

hitting F5, and requests works .... til the next error.

Seems unstable ...

someone has got better results on gae/py37 ?
should it work ?
